cohort: The study included 100 antenatal women at 34-38 weeks gestation, consisting of 50 FGR cases and 50 gestational age-matched controls.
finding: Reduced CPR and CUR are strong predictors of adverse perinatal outcomes in late-onset FGR, with CUR showing superior predictive performance and combined CPR and CUR enhancing risk stratification.
mod_finding: Cesarean for fetal distress was identified as an adverse perinatal outcome, occurring more frequently in FGR cases.
cross-section timing: During the antenatal period, specifically at 34-38 weeks gestation.
